result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights. The environment is car-centric, with pedestrians forced to use the paved shoulder or roadway, which is particularly hazardous in the visible wet weather conditions.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are provided at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of dedicated walkways forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto unprotected shoulders, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Reduced Visibility and Traction
hazards.description: Wet road conditions reduce vehicle braking efficiency and pedestrian visibility, exacerbating the risks posed by the lack of infrastructure.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Network Construction
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained concrete sidewalk separated from a multi-lane roadway by a narrow grass buffer. The environment lacks visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures, suggesting a priority for vehicular throughput.

hazards.name: Narrow separation buffer
hazards.description: The grass strip between the sidewalk and the roadway is narrow, offering little protection from vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road, between the white line and the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing points
hazards.description: No designated crossing areas are visible for a significant stretch of the road.

interventions.title: Widen Buffer
interventions.description: Increase the width of the grass buffer or add physical barriers to enhance pedestrian protection.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signage to facilitate safe road crossings.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a narrow vegetated strip and a marked bike lane. A marked crosswalk with a pedestrian signal is visible in the distance, providing a designated crossing point, though the road surface is wet and lacks physical barriers between travel modes.

hazards.name: Wet Road Surface
hazards.description: The roadway is visibly wet, which increases vehicle braking distances and can reduce the visibility of pavement markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway surface

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: The bike lane and sidewalk are separated from motor vehicle traffic only by paint and a narrow unpaved strip, offering no physical protection from errant vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Between the travel lane and the bike lane/sidewalk

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical vertical delineators or a concrete curb to separate the bike lane from the motor vehicle travel lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crossing point to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and improve their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Enhance the existing crosswalk with ladder or continental style markings to increase its visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, but the wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians. A bus shelter is present, though the overall environment lacks dedicated pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions to enhance safety.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wet road surface
hazards.description: Rainy conditions reduce vehicle braking efficiency and pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the wide shoulder to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to inform walkers of remaining crossing time.
